app.title: Blender's UI and Runtime: Much Faster Than GPUI
app.author: ppmpreetham
app.description: Blender add‑on that replaces the default UI and runtime with a faster, more responsive implementation.
proposed_tests: Install the add‑on into Blender and verify the UI loads without errors.
Run Blender in headless mode with the add‑on enabled and capture performance metrics.
Compare FPS and memory usage between the default UI and BUI on a sample scene.
